question: For parts below their reorder point (available stock across warehouses), who is the supplier? Skip parts we make ourselves.
gold_sql: SELECT p.part_number, s.name FROM parts p JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id=p.supplier_id JOIN inventory i ON i.part_id=p.part_id GROUP BY p.part_id HAVING SUM(i.qty_on_hand-i.qty_allocated) < p.reorder_point
pred_sql:
SELECT p."part_id",
       p."description",
       s."name" AS "supplier_name",
       SUM(i."qty_on_hand" - i."qty_allocated") AS "available_qty",
       p."reorder_point"
FROM parts p
JOIN inventory i ON i."part_id" = p."part_id"
LEFT JOIN suppliers s ON s."supplier_id" = p."supplier_id"
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM work_orders w
    WHERE w."part_id" = p."part_id"
)
GROUP BY p."part_id", p."description", s."name", p."reorder_point"
HAVING SUM(i."qty_on_hand" - i."qty_allocated") < p."reorder_point"
ORDER BY "available_qty" ASC
LIMIT 5;
